otherPublication.reason: This run validates only its own publication manifest; the other frontend is not accepted by these results.

backendReported.verification: Owner-reported identity only; anonymous browser checks do not independently verify deployed backend source.

sourceIdentityEvidence.scope: Independent local Git tree equality for these build inputs only; source commit identities remain distinct.

provenance: Publisher-reported frontend/backend SHA and deployment IDs; static HTTP bytes are compared to supplied manifests before/after. Anonymous access does not establish authenticated cloud workflow, backend source identity or durable storage.
scope: Four anonymous entry scenarios: translated empty sign-in, language persistence, viewport fit and JSON 401. No sign-in, account, task, report, photo, cloud write, restart or full API acceptance.
artifactPolicy: Only intentional screenshots after empty-input and signed-out checks; no trace, video, error-context, login credentials or raw DOM.
